description: SPARRA is a predictive AI model that outputs scores for approximately 4.3 million individuals in Scotland to identify high-risk patients for emergency hospital admission.

instances.assertion: SPARRA is a predictive AI model that outputs scores for approximately 4.3 million individuals in Scotland to identify high-risk patients for emergency hospital admission.
The SPARRA model was constructed using logistic regression on patient-level data including inpatient admissions, prescriptions, and emergency department attendances.
The SPARRA model predicts a patient's risk of emergency hospital admission within 12 months using logistic regression on patient-level data.
The SPARRA AI model predicts a patient's risk of emergency hospital admission within 12 months, outputting scores from 1 to 99.
